properties.evidence: The finding that `rule_id` silently resolves to EnvironmentRule, with no description saying so, is what prompted this change — and this change addresses only the SAYING half: violates_rule, complies_with and set_violation_status now state the type on the served surface. The finding stays OPEN because its other half, that no edge path reaches a DesignRule at all, is untouched and is a separate decision.
